result.question: What was Apple's net income in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer:
Apple's net income for fiscal year 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025) was $112,010 million, or approximately $112.0 billion. The same amount appears in the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, where net income is listed as 112,010 (in millions) for the same period [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p004]. The XBRL fact for NetIncomeLoss for the period ending 2025-09-27 reports 112,010,000,000 USD [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-09-27]. For comparison, net income was $93,736 million in fiscal 2024 and $96,995 million in fiscal 2023 [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001].
